title: (Generalized) Spine Subalgebras of Fourier-Stieltjes algebras and their Homomorphisms
summary: For any upper semilattice ${\cal D}$ of locally precompact topologies on a locally compact group $G$, we define an associated generalized spine subalgebra $A^*_{\cal D}(G)$ of the Fourier-Stieltjes algebra $B(G)$. We show that $A^*_{\cal D}(G)$ is a semilattice-graded $\ell^1$-direct sum of maximal copies of Fourier algebras and we identify its spectrum as a semilattice of groups. We build a collection of examples of generalized spine algebras over whose spectra we exhibit fine control.
